install: Run WuWa-VR-Setup.exe to install WuWa VR for your Windows user, then open the WuWa VR shortcut. This small installer does not include the VR mod: the first Install VR needs internet to download it. No separate Python installation is needed.
steps: 01 · Game. Choose your Kuro or Steam installation. A saved choice is kept; if several installations are found, choose one. For Steam, browse to Wuthering Waves.exe if needed. You need your own copy of the game.
02 · Install VR. Read and accept the account-risk notice, then install the selected VR version. Existing settings and backups are kept.

03 · Headset or simulator. Start your headset software and select its valid runtime, or explicitly choose the bundled simulator. Once the runtime is ready, select Launch in VR and accept Windows permission. Steam starts through Steam; for Kuro, press Play in its launcher.
controls: In game, L3 + R3 opens the WuWa VR menu: point with a VR controller's laser and pull the trigger, or use the gamepad or mouse. UEVR's full settings are on its Menu page: All settings (classic UEVR menu). L3 + A / Cross recenters; L3 + B / Circle shows or hides the game UI. Xbox, PlayStation and VR controller controls.
guide: Full setup, update and recovery steps
updates: The Launcher app and VR package have separate status. Update the app to 1.2.0, then choose 1.2.0 beta in step 02 and install it. The app update keeps your package choice, including a deliberate rollback. Check updates refreshes availability; it does not install or switch anything.
runtime: Launch is available only with a valid headset runtime or the simulator from your selected installed VR package. If Windows still points at an older simulator, choose Use bundled simulator after closing the game and injector. Runtime switching is explicit and may ask for Windows permission; opening or updating the app never changes it automatically.
accepted: The owner played this release in the headset (Valve Index controllers with a Bigscreen Beyond; a Meta Quest Pro with a Reality Runner treadmill) through private tests: the new VR menu with the laser and a gamepad, the view shortcuts, full-VR close-ups that follow the camera without getting stuck, blur in both eyes, from the start of a story scene, the menu in front of the stereo screen, a gamepad taking over at once from a put-down controller, the controls cards and the translated menu and VR controllers and a Reality Runner treadmill working together. The last test's additions (treadmill runs in the VR menu, the Controllers page, ambient occlusion off, the L3 card pinned low) and recording in 5-minute parts still need a headset check. In Move menu the VR thumbstick does not change the distance yet (use Menu distance). Many dialogue close-ups still sit wider than the 2D shot, and in full VR the HUD can stay squashed until ESC.
rim: Suppress mismatched NPC rim lighting is under VR → WuWa Controls and starts off. It suppresses the toon-rim effect that produced extra bright contours in the tested NPC scene. It also removes that intended effect from nearby characters that use it. Turning it off restores the prior value if the workaround still owns it. The underlying stereo rendering fault is unresolved.
limits: In full VR the HUD can stay squashed after a view switch or a new area until you open and close ESC, many dialogue close-ups sit wider than the 2D shot, and dialogue runs slower than on the screens (a lower render resolution on the menu's Fixes page helps). Scene/dialogue loading stalls and moving backgrounds behind flat menus remain open; mono theatre can help with menus. Some NPC lighting, reflections and fog/VFX still need testing. Automatic cinematic switching is experimental and off by default. Epic injection and broad headset compatibility remain unverified.
cutscenes: Three views: fully hold LT + RT first, then click R3 for the next one (full VR, stereoscopic screen, mono theatre with the same scene and HUD for both eyes); hold R3 for 0.8 seconds instead to go straight back to full VR. LT + RT, then click L3 turns blur (depth of field) on or off. Release all controls before repeating, with the menu and HUD/mouse adjustment closed. Automatic cinema is experimental and off by default; an actual prerendered movie has not been tested. Keep the manual shortcut available.
risk: Use at your own risk. This unofficial mod injects into the game; anti-cheat may restrict or ban an account. It is not approved by Kuro Games.
portable: The portable ZIP is an advanced fallback: extract the whole archive, keep its app and python folders together, and open WuWa VR Launcher.exe. It uses the older browser interface and does not install or self-update the desktop app. The installer is the recommended starting point.
archive: Older translated setup instructions below describe the portable interface. Use the current installer steps in English or Simplified Chinese for the desktop app.
updateFallback: If the old launcher blocks its update, close the app and use the new WuWa-VR-Setup.exe from this website. This installs the app update; it does not guarantee that a stalled startup worker has stopped. Review remaining processes before changing the VR package or runtime.
recovery: In Troubleshooting → Stuck launcher processes, choose Find stuck launcher processes. Review each name, PID, role, start time, path and eligibility; elevation may be requested. Nothing is selected automatically. Choose an eligible verified launcher helper or startup worker, then use Stop selected and confirm the listed processes. Game, Steam, headset/runtime and injector processes are not termination targets. Runtime/profile changes and active or unknown recording state remain protected. Review each result, then explicitly choose Retry connection when ready; recovery does not reconnect or launch the game automatically. An inconclusive process may require manual handling; copy diagnostics instead of guessing from its name. If cancellation is not acknowledged, review the shown worker identity in recovery. If Close cannot shut down the helper, Close launcher only offers an explicit way to exit the window while leaving background work untouched; it is not a claim that the worker stopped. Reinstalling preserves user data and does not end existing workers. Troubleshooting → Prepare uninstall removes verified downloads after confirmation when idle. Windows Apps uninstall also attempts bounded cleanup. Active OpenXR packages, busy or unverified files, recordings, backups and settings are retained. Any remaining-file report opens after uninstall with exact reasons.
banner: New VR menu (laser, gamepad or mouse), controls cards, ten languages, VR controllers and treadmill runs, and a three-view shortcut.
